answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy refuses to treat claims as credentials. Every payout crosses a bridge that only verifiable work can pass: peers replay the result independently before counting it, so a new mask with an old trick is turned away at the border. Cheap identities become a desert, not an oasis - spawning clones yields no water, only the cost of maintaining them. Trust spreads as a slow ripple from each confirmed contribution, so influence can never be minted overnight, only earned transaction by transaction.
